integrity_note: Analytical proof for the universal inequality and two equality orbits; exact exhaustive arithmetic for finite-alphabet refinements. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted lower bound and equality classification assume twelve unit-modulus coefficients on the type-A3 root frequency set. Exact finite-alphabet minima are determined for q=2,3,4,5,6, and the attainment criterion for the universal minimum is proved for every q>=2. No arbitrary-amplitude, higher-rank, or aliased-grid theorem is claimed.
title: A sharp fourth-moment law and six-phase rigidity for the twelve-root \(A_3\) Fourier aperture
